name: Fagin's Den (The Fishermen's Cottages)
suitableFor: Small families or couples, including dog owners
parking: Free parking on the Eastern Esplanade, a couple of minutes' walk
beachAccess: About 100 metres from the beach in Broadstairs
confirmedFeatures: Two bedrooms, sleeps four, Dickens-themed interior, dogs welcome
overview: Fagin's Den is a Dickens-themed holiday cottage on Church Road in Broadstairs, built around the 1860s and about 100 metres from the beach. It has two bedrooms and sleeps four, and well-behaved dogs are welcome. Joss Bay is a short drive north along the coast.
surfTripFit: A dog-friendly self-catering base close to the Broadstairs beaches and a short drive from Joss Bay.
